name: cpa-map
description: Every Meta or Google ad on one map (log lifetime spend × CPA) from BlueAlpha data, with account, target, kill and scale lines. Work the playbook: turn paused winners back on, kill and scale what's live, compare like with like by format, grade each funnel stage on its own metric. Exports a GrowthCast report, slide deck, action plan and account readout.
